education.name: Hemoglobin
education.explanation: Hemoglobin is an oxygen-carrying protein in red blood cells. This explanation does not interpret an individual result.

education.name: Blood glucose
education.explanation: Glucose is a sugar used for energy. Test timing and sample context matter when discussing a measurement.

education.name: Total cholesterol
education.explanation: A lipid panel reports several blood fat measurements. Total cholesterol is one part of that panel.

education.name: HDL cholesterol
education.explanation: HDL is one cholesterol measurement in a lipid panel. Its meaning needs context alongside other measurements.

education.name: LDL cholesterol
education.explanation: LDL is another cholesterol measurement in a lipid panel. This tool does not evaluate personal cardiovascular risk.

education.name: Triglycerides
education.explanation: Triglycerides are fats measured as part of many lipid panels. A reported interval is specific to its document and context.

education.name: White blood cell count
education.explanation: This count measures white blood cells, which are part of the immune system. It cannot identify a condition on its own.

education.name: Platelet count
education.explanation: Platelets help blood clot. A platelet count measures how many are in a blood sample.

education.name: Creatinine
education.explanation: Creatinine is a waste product measured in blood or urine tests. The sample type and other information matter for interpretation.

warnings: Every result needs manual transcription review; no confidence score is estimated.
A synthetic marker and acknowledgement cannot prove that a document contains no personal information.
disclaimer: Educational extraction only. Review the transcription. Not a medical diagnosis.
